title: Chat session
description: One chat session: its id, its board (none yet for a session started in a folder with no board open), the agent and model it runs, when it started, and the agent id it writes as.

session.description: The session's id; the chat routes name it in their path.

board.description: The board the session belongs to. Left out while a session started in the folder has none: it moves to the first board its agent creates, and keeps it.

agentId.description: The agent id the session's agent writes on the board as (its `join` line), never a secret: the page works out from it which of the person's answers that agent is told.
